join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set displayWarnings on
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!filter caps
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!filter caps
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter caps what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !filter caps on|off|percent|minchars|mincaps|status


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Filters are now enabled.


handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random :this is a normal message
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter caps status
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Caps filter=false, percent=50, minchars=0, mincaps=6


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter caps on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Caps filter is now enabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter caps on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Caps filter is already enabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter caps off
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Caps filter is now disabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter caps off
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Caps filter is already disabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter caps on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Caps filter is now enabled.

send hortbot #foobar [HB] Random, please don't shout or talk in all caps - warning


handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random :HAHAHAHA lol this is all okay
no_send

no_send


# Caps percent

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter caps percent
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !filter caps percent <0-100>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter caps percent 101
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !filter caps percent <0-100>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter caps percent -1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !filter caps percent <0-100>


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter caps percent 25
